listing.name: Pangya: Fantasy Golf — pangya-recomp (kromossomom-debug)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Static native title code with HLE/fallback; no broad gameplay or full completion established. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: USA ULUS10438 PangyaFantasyGolf own UMD ISO. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: build.sh ownISO patches PPSSPP HLE runtime and generates game C++; dist/pangya uses original ISO. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.

warnings: Static native title code with HLE/fallback; no broad gameplay or full completion established. These are the project’s reports; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
